About Evergreen Goodwill
Evergreen Goodwill of Northwest Washington is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization founded in 1923 and a leading provider of tuition-free job training, education, and job placement. The organization employs over 2,000 people and operates job-training centers, nonprofit retail stores, and donation sites across King, Snohomish, Skagit, Whatcom, and Kitsap Counties.
Every day, Evergreen Goodwill connects people with the jobs, services, and skills they need because Jobs Change Lives.
About the Position
The Director, Supply Chain & Continuous Improvement is a Retail leadership role responsible for strengthening outlet performance, donation flow, inventory allocation, facility throughput, safety, and continuous improvement discipline across assigned Retail operations. This position reports to the SVP, Customer Experience, Retail & Revenue Growth and directly supervises the Regional Director of Outlets.
This leader establishes practical, scalable operating standards for managed outlet locations and related warehouse/processing activities. The role is accountable for improving productivity, reducing defects, shrink, dwell time, and cost-to-serve, and sustaining consistent processes across assigned sites.
The position is not responsible for transportation routing, salvage and recycling operations, or enterprise supply chain analytics, but will partner cross-functionally where those areas intersect with Retail and outlet performance.
Scope of Accountability
* Lead operational improvement for assigned Retail outlet locations and related warehouse/processing activities.
* Own outlet inventory flow and allocation strategies that improve product availability, inventory turns, and operating efficiency.
* Design and sustain continuous improvement routines that improve productivity, throughput, safety, consistency, and customer-facing quality.
* Provide leadership and accountability for the Regional Director of Outlets and assigned outlet leadership teams.
* Partner with Retail, E-Commerce, Logistics, Finance, Technology, Environmental Health & Safety, and Mission leaders to align priorities while maintaining clear ownership boundaries.
Key Responsibilities
Continuous Improvement & Operating Standards

...

* Lead improvement events from diagnosis through implementation, adoption, and sustained performance.
* Translate process improvements into measurable business outcomes, including labor productivity, inventory movement, margin support, and cost-to-serve reduction.
* Build leader capability through structured routines, coaching, documentation, and accountability to defined performance targets.
Outlet & Warehouse/Processing Operations

...

* Lead layout optimization, capacity planning, and flow redesign to reduce non-value-added movement and improve productivity.
* Implement daily huddles, shift handoffs, visual management boards, and operating cadences that support predictable performance and accountability.
Donation Flow & Inventory Allocation
* Optimize donation and inventory flow within the Retail/outlet operating model from intake through outlet presentation and replenishment support.
* Build allocation discipline so product is routed to the appropriate channel or outlet at the right pace and quality standard.
* Reduce dwell time, improve inventory turns, and address aged inventory through system-level process changes.
* Provide leaders with clear visibility into throughput, constraints, inventory aging, allocation quality, and outlet readiness.
Safety Culture & Injury Reduction
* Drive measurable reductions in Total Recordable Incident Rate (TRIR) across managed facilities through system-level safety design in partnership with Environmental Health & Safety.
* Apply EGNW Environmental Health & Safety policies and procedures within managed sites and ensure operational leaders consistently follow required safety practices.
* Embed safety into process design, including ergonomic layout, mistake-proofing, workflow design, and visual controls that help prevent injury.
* Build a near-miss and hazard reporting culture grounded in trust, learning, timely follow-up, and problem-solving.
* Partner with Environmental Health & Safety on incident trend review, corrective action planning, and sustainable process improvements that reduce risk exposure.
Cross-Functional Leadership & Change Management
* Partner with Retail, E-Commerce, Logistics, Finance, Technology, Environmental Health & Safety, and Mission leaders to align process improvement priorities with operational and mission outcomes.
* Lead change through data, relationships, operational credibility, and a clear understanding of multi-site complexity.
* Represent outlet performance, continuous improvement progress, and inventory flow opportunities in leadership discussions.
* Communicate operational performance, risks, tradeoffs, and recommendations in a clear and business-focused manner.
* Create documentation, routines, and transition-ready systems that support continuity, scalability, and sustainable performance.
Leadership Expectations
* Lead, coach, and develop high-performing outlet operations leaders with clear expectations, measurable goals, and regular accountability routines.
* Model EGNW values and promote a culture of dignity, respect, inclusion, safety, accountability, and continuous learning.
* Build strong alignment with Retail and Admin leadership and resolve tradeoffs that affect execution, customer experience, employee experience, and mission outcomes.
* Develop a bench of operations leaders who can sustain high standards and scale improved practices across the outlet network.
* Use sound judgment and discretion when handling sensitive organizational, employee, operational, and financial information.
Required Qualifications
* 8 to 10 years of progressive operations, retail operations, warehouse/processing, production, supply chain, or comparable multi-site leadership experience.
* Demonstrated experience leading process improvement initiatives that produce measurable results in productivity, throughput, cost, quality, safety, or inventory flow.
* Experience leading teams, developing operational leaders, and creating accountability across multiple sites or complex operating environments.
* Working knowledge of continuous improvement tools such as value stream mapping, standard work, visual management, root cause analysis, time studies, layout optimization, and daily management routines.
* Strong operational problem-solving skills, including the ability to diagnose constraints, prioritize work, implement solutions, and sustain results.
* Ability to analyze operational data, identify trends, and translate findings into clear action plans and leadership recommendations.
* Strong communication, facilitation, and cross-functional partnership skills.
* Commitment to safety, equity, inclusion, mission impact, and ethical leadership.
Preferred Qualifications
* Bachelor's degree in business, operations management, supply chain, industrial engineering, organizational leadership, or a related field.
* Lean, Six Sigma, Kaizen, Toyota Production System, or comparable continuous improvement certification or formal training.
* Experience in nonprofit social enterprise, thrift retail, outlet operations, donation-based retail, distribution, warehouse, manufacturing, or multi-unit retail environments.
* Experience improving safety outcomes through process design, ergonomic improvements, visual controls, and operational leadership routines.
* Experience with inventory allocation, replenishment support, production standards, and multi-site operating cadence design.
Physical Requirements / Work Environment
* Work is performed in both office and operational environments, including outlet locations, warehouse/processing areas, and administrative settings.
* Must be able to travel between assigned sites as needed to observe workflows, coach leaders, participate in improvement events, and support implementation.
* Role may require standing, walking, and observing operational processes for extended periods in active production and retail environments.

This leadership role is responsible for directing all quality assurance and quality systems activities supporting Large Form Assembly (LFA) manufacturing operations. The position partners closely with Operations, Engineering, Supply Chain, and customers to ensure compliance with quality standards, regulatory requirements, and continuous improvement initiatives.
The role provides strategic oversight for quality planning, product introduction, customer satisfaction, and business process excellence.
How will you make an impact?
As the Quality Director, you will lead the development and execution of world-class quality systems that ensure product reliability, regulatory compliance, and customer satisfaction. You will drive continuous improvement initiatives, strengthen quality culture, and establish scalable processes that support business growth while maintaining the highest standards of operational excellence.
What will you do?
* Lead the design, implementation, and maintenance of quality systems, policies, and procedures supporting Large Form Assembly products and operations.
* Establish short- and long-term quality objectives aligned with business strategy and customer requirements.
* Provide leadership and guidance to Quality Managers, Engineers, and quality personnel to ensure organizational effectiveness and compliance.
* Drive collaboration between Quality and cross-functional teams including Operations, Engineering, Manufacturing, and Supply Chain.
* Serve as the primary escalation point for significant quality issues, customer concerns, and nonconformance investigations.
* Develop and maintain quality evaluation, inspection, testing, and control systems in accordance with customer, regulatory, and company requirements.
* Direct internal and external quality audits, oversee corrective and preventive actions (CAPA), and ensure timely closure of identified gaps.
* Utilize statistical analysis and quality methodologies to identify improvement opportunities and reduce the cost of poor quality.
* Ensure compliance with ISO 9001 and other applicable industry, regulatory, and customer-specific standards.
* Lead risk-based quality planning activities for new product introductions and process transfers.
* Review and communicate quality performance metrics, business reports, and quality system effectiveness to senior leadership and customers.
* Partner directly with customers to address requirements, drive issue resolution, and strengthen business relationships.
* Lead continuous improvement initiatives that create sustainable, repeatable, and measurable operational improvements.
* Ensure initial and ongoing validation activities are performed in support of quality and GMP-related systems as applicable.
* Share best practices across sites and support enterprise-wide quality initiatives.
* Perform other duties and responsibilities as assigned.
How will you get here?
**Minimum Qualifications
**
* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Manufacturing, Technology, Quality, or a related discipline.
* 10+ years of progressive quality leadership experience within a manufacturing environment.
* Proven experience leading quality organizations, including managers and engineering teams.
* Experience implementing and maintaining quality management systems, audit programs, and corrective action processes.
* Strong understanding of statistical quality methods, root cause analysis, and continuous improvement methodologies.
* Demonstrated ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders and drive organizational change.
* Excellent written, verbal, presentation, and customer-facing communication skills.
**Knowledge, Skills, Abilities
**
* Strategic leadership and organizational development capabilities.
* Expertise in quality systems, product quality assurance, and process control methodologies.
* Strong knowledge of ISO 9001 and regulatory compliance requirements.
* Ability to lead quality audits, investigations, and corrective action programs.
* Experience managing customer escalations and complex quality issues.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Proven ability to build high-performing teams and develop talent.
* Effective project management, prioritization, and decision-making abilities.
* Success operating within matrixed and collaborative global organizations.
* Strong interpersonal skills with a focus on teamwork and customer satisfaction.
**Preferred Qualifications
**
* Master's degree in Engineering, Technology, Quality, or a related field.
* Large Form Factor (LFF) or Large Form Assembly (LFA) manufacturing experience.
* ASQ certifications such as Certified Quality Engineer (CQE), Certified Manager of Quality/Organizational Excellence (CMQ/OE), or equivalent.
* Experience supporting highly regulated manufacturing environments.
* Demonstrated success leading enterprise-wide quality transformation initiatives.

* A culture focused on innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
* Opportunities to lead high-impact strategic quality initiatives.
* Career growth within a global manufacturing and technology organization.
* Exposure to diverse customers, products, and advanced manufacturing technologies.
* Competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits package.
* The opportunity to make a lasting impact on operational excellence and customer success.

** **Compensation: $180K - $220K
** The plant manager plays a significant role in our company, providing direction and leadership to the operations, engineering, maintenance, logistics, and quality departments.
This role is instrumental in supporting our corporate profit objectives through continuous improvement in machinery, practices, and procedures that reduce product costs, maintain consistently high product quality standards, and enhance employee satisfaction. The role's influence on maintaining high product quality standards is crucial in delivering quality products to our customers.
This role also provides leadership that directly impacts improvement programs and systems (Lean). The operations manager fulfills the responsibilities of this role when vacant.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:
**
* The following duties and responsibilities are representative. Other duties may be assigned.
* Provide sound budgeting and planning for the manufacturing and support operations.
* Ability to manage and lead in a Lean environment.
* Ensure customer satisfaction and trust regarding product quality and on-time performance.
* Ensure optimum effectiveness in scrap control, manufacturing efficiency (OEE), and costs.
* Ensure an effective Product Safety environment by adhering to US FDA, Dairy, HACCP, AIB, and all other agreed-upon product safety requirements.
* Provide effective leadership for the facility’s Product Safety Systems, Employee Safety Systems, and their committees.
* Provide the leadership that supports our quality systems, including efforts regarding NPA-SAFE and customer-required systems.
* Foster an environment of open communications and trust with all employees.
* Ensure sound Preventive Maintenance and Repair Programs (TPM).
* Conducts management meetings with plant personnel to establish, delineate, and review policies, coordinate functions and operations between departments, and establish responsibilities and procedures to attain objectives.
* Analyzes, evaluates, and presents information concerning factors such as business situations, production capabilities, manufacturing problems, and design and development of new products for consideration by other management team members
* Keeps management team abreast of significant issues or developments identified during activities and actions being taken to improve the situation.
* Facilitates employee teams to build cohesiveness and improve the overall results of the respective teams’ tasks.
* Develop strategies and programs that improve the productivity and efficiency of the company's various work processes.
* Reviews technical problems and procedures of departments and recommends solutions to problems or procedure changes.
* Participate in capital planning, implementation, and new product development efforts.
* Ensure practical personnel orientation, training, and development programs.
* Establish operating indicators (metrics) that measure departmental performance regularly and communicate this information to upper management and critical customers.
* This role carries out supervisory responsibilities following the organization’s policies and applicable laws.
Responsibilities for supervising direct reports include hiring, training, and planning that clearly measure departmental performance, regularly assigning and directing work, appraising performance, rewarding and coaching employees, and addressing complaints and resolving problems.
* Responsible for overseeing food safety.
**YOU BRING THESE SKILLS, EXPERIENCE & EDUCATION:
**
* Bachelor's degree in a technical field from an accredited four-year college or university.
**SKILLS & EXPERIENCE:
**
* Customer Orientation
* Improve Workforce Engagement
* Lean/Six Sigma Fundamentals
* Manufacturing Metrics
* Sustainability/Social Responsibilities (Scholle)
* Acting Decisively
* Acting Strategically
* Adapting to Change
* Assembling Talent
* Managing Political Situations
**IDEAL CANDIDATES HAVE THESE COMPETENCIES** **:
** We are looking for people who are willing to consistently achieve results, even under challenging circumstances. These employees create a climate where everyone is motivated to do their best to help the organization achieve its objectives.
If you actively seek new ways to grow, be challenged, and develop people to meet their career and the organization’s goals, SIG is the place for you. To deliver better for our customers, our future colleagues build strong customer relationships and deliver customer-centric solutions.
Finally, we are looking for colleagues who build partnerships and work collaboratively with others to meet shared objectives. Are you someone who applies knowledge of business and the marketplace to advance the organization’s goals? Can you create new and better ways for the organization to be successful? If the answer is ‘yes,’ come and join us.
**WE OFFER:
**
* Day 1 Benefits Enrollment
* Retirement 401K Matching
* Employee Assistance Program
* Identity Theft Protection Plan
* Tuition Reimbursement
* And more…
**OUR PROMISE
** SIG is the place for you to build something incredible. If you join us, you will be part of a globally successful international company leading in sustainability, technology, and more industry. We consider ourselves the career launchpad - a place to develop yourself fast with real work, experience, and opportunities to build skills.
You will be part of a highly motivated and dynamic team, with personal development opportunities, training, and coaching opportunities from senior team members. If you show skill and willingness to learn, we'll back you.
**About Sig
** SIG is a leading provider of packaging systems and solutions for the better. We partner with our customers to bring food products to consumers worldwide in a safe, sustainable, and affordable way. We are the only packaging system supplier covering cartons, pouches, and bag-in-boxes.
Our versatile technology and product innovation capacity enable us to deliver better for customers, consumers, and the world. Sustainability guides us; technology empowers us, but our people’s passion and drive will allow us to deliver better.
Founded in 1853, SIG is headquartered in Neuhausen, Switzerland, and listed on the SIX Swiss Exchange.
